_about: Light crafting at the camp workbench (scripts/camp/camp_build.gd craft). A player within reach_m of the workbench (bench_model in data/clearing.json) opens its panel and picks a recipe; crafting is instant and never fails. A recipe makes one of a build kind (data/build.json) and costs coins and materials (item -> count), taken from the crafter's Pack first and then the camp box. What is crafted goes into the camp's build kit, shared by both players, and build mode places it from there; packing it away puts it back in the kit. Kinds marked free in data/build.json (the tent pitch) are always in the kit. Recipes are listed in this order; one that names a project (data/projects.json) shows only once that project is done. fire: the camp fire (model in data/clearing.json) grows in levels, upgraded at the fire itself (within data/fishing.json fires reach) for coins and materials like a recipe: each level adds its model on top of the fire and scales the fire light's range and energy by light_scale; the fire's collider grows to collide_m so nobody stands on the ring. The camp's fire.level (0 to the number of levels) is shared and saved. Names: data/text.json fire.<id>.
